mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MBTI_TEST_RESULT ( MBTI_TEST_RESULT_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, MBTI_TYPE, RESULT_TITLE, RESULT_EMOJI, TAGS, BEST_MATCH_MBTI, MATCH_DESC, ANSWERS, CREATED_AT) VALUES ( SEQ_MBTI_TEST_RESULT.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{mbtiType}, #{resultTitle}, #{resultEmoji}, #{tags}, #{bestMatchMbti}, #{matchDesc}, #{answers}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MBTI_TEST_RESULT_SEQ AS mbtiTestResultSeq, MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, MBTI_TYPE AS mbtiType, RESULT_TITLE AS resultTitle, RESULT_EMOJI AS resultEmoji, TAGS AS tags, BEST_MATCH_MBTI AS bestMatchMbti, MATCH_DESC AS matchDesc, ANSWERS AS answers, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM MBTI_TEST_RESULT WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY MBTI_TEST_RESULT_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
